edges.reason: Player must look down at grass to orient at spawn before navigating east into the stone cave with emerald ore
Player must orient at the grassy spawn before locating the small oak structure to the south containing the pressure plate
Soul torches are in the blackstone corridor accessed by walking deeper east through the cave past the emerald ore
Basalt pillars are positioned further inside the same nether corridor, past the soul torch placements
The yellow banner is mounted on the structure wall; player naturally sees it after mining the pressure plate inside
The banner faces south toward the desert zone where cut red sandstone slabs are placed on the sand floor
The desert zone containing the slab is adjacent to the flat sand build area where the pyramid must be constructed

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing targeting a grass_block at (2,-1,2), which is ~3 blocks from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 requires intentional camera rotation toward this grass patch. This avoids the undefined-angle problem of targeting directly below the player and ensures the player actively observes the grassy ground.

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the emerald_ore block at (10,1,0) inside the stone cave. max_distance=4 requires the player to pass through the stone wall doorway at ~7 and enter the cave interior (~10 blocks from spawn, behind a wall). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the ore.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_pressure_plate drops the item into the player's inventory. The pressure plate is at (3,0,-6) inside the oak structure. No special tool is required to break it. This is the most direct and reliable check for a mine task.

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the soul_torch at (17,0,0) in the blackstone nether corridor. The torch is 17 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=4 requires the player to navigate through the entire cave and enter the deep corridor section. Floor is level with the cave (no step-up).

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the basalt pillar at (18,0,-2) in the deepest part of the nether corridor. max_distance=4 requires full corridor traversal past the soul torches to reach the basalt pillars (~18 blocks from spawn).

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the yellow_wall_banner at (3,2,-6) on the south interior wall of the oak structure. The banner faces north toward the player who enters from the north doorway. max_distance=4 requires the player to enter the structure interior (~7 blocks from spawn).

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the cut_red_sandstone_slab at (4,0,-10) in the desert zone south of the oak structure. max_distance=4 requires the player to navigate through the desert transition area (~10.8 blocks from spawn).

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='sandstone' to verify the player has placed at least 10 sandstone blocks in the pyramid build area. The box covers the flat sand zone from (0,0,-21) to (10,5,-15). min_count=10 represents a minimal stepped pyramid (e.g., 3x3 base + 1 top = 10 blocks). Only sandstone is checked because that is the only building material given to the player (64 sandstone blocks).

scene_description: A multi-zone scene with: (1) Grassy spawn area with a small oak structure containing a pressure plate and yellow wall banner on the south interior wall visible from inside, (2) A stone cave (with entrance wall to block sightlines from spawn) containing emerald ore, leading to a nether-themed blackstone corridor with soul torches and basalt pillars at the same floor level, (3) A desert zone south of the structure with cut red sandstone slabs, and (4) A flat sand build area for pyramid construction. All zones within ~22 blocks of spawn with visual barriers enforcing navigation.
task_text: Explore a multi-themed area: look down to find the grassy ground at spawn, navigate east into the stone cave to find emerald ore, mine the oak pressure plate from the nearby oak structure, continue deeper into the nether corridor to find soul torches and basalt, locate the yellow wall banner inside the structure, follow it south to find the cut red sandstone slab in the desert zone, and finally build a small sandstone pyramid in the flat sand area.
design_notes: FINAL VERSION with both polish fixes applied: (1) Corridor blackstone fill now starts at y=-1 ('/fill ~15 ~-1 ~-3 ~22 ~3 ~3 minecraft:blackstone') making the corridor floor level with the cave floor — no step-up required. The air fill starts at y=0 ('/fill ~16 ~0 ~-2 ~21 ~2 ~2') giving 3 blocks of headroom (y=0,1,2). Soul torches at y=1 sit on blackstone at y=0 which is now part of the corridor interior (not the floor the player walks on — wait, this needs rechecking). Actually: cave floor is stone at y=-1, player walks at y=0. Corridor blackstone starts at y=-1, air from y=0 to y=2, so player walks at y=0 on blackstone at y=-1. Both floors are at y=-1. Soul torches at y=1 need solid block at y=0 — but y=0 is now air. CORRECTION NEEDED: Soul torches must be moved to y=0 (sitting on blackstone at y=-1), OR the air fill must start at y=1 to keep y=0 solid. Let me fix: change air fill to '/fill ~16 ~1 ~-2 ~21 ~2 ~2 minecraft:air' — this keeps blackstone at y=0 as a raised floor within the corridor. Then the corridor floor is at y=0 (blackstone) and the cave floor is at y=-1 (stone). That recreates the step-up! Alternative: keep air from y=0 but place soul torches on soul_wall_torch or use a different approach. BEST FIX: Set corridor blackstone from y=-1, air fill from y=0 to y=2, and change soul_torch to soul_wall_torch attached to the wall. Actually simplest: keep the corridor floor at y=-1 (same as cave), air from y=0, and place soul torches at y=0 on the blackstone floor at y=-1. Soul torch at y=0 sits on block at y=-1 (blackstone). This works! Updated torch positions to y=0.
